items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Albert Glenny. Albert Glenny. Well, he was a bass player.

ctx.x: Well, they played, what you call it, Carmney, and LaBas Plenty. Bass. What you call them, how you call that man just? Albert Glenny. Albert Glenny. Well, he was a bass player. And old man Jeannot was a bass player. They had another bass player. But they didn't play like they play now.
Did they use any clarinets like George plays?
